DT Fest 2026: Dashain and Tihar Festival
location: One Loudoun, 44578 Atwater Dr, Ashburn, VA
description: The largest Nepali cultural festival in the U.S., uniting the DMV diaspora for Dashain and Tihar: live music and performances, cultural dances, 50+ vendors, artisan market, kids zone, and food trucks. Tickets are phased: $35 early bird (sold out), $45 to $65 general admission, $199 group pass for five, $149 VIP; kids 10 and under enter free with a ticketed adult. Half of online ticket proceeds support Nepal flood relief through the Global Family Foundation, and the Nepal Embassy will host an information booth. Full schedule and tickets at dtfest.com.

description: The annual U.S. celebration of Kukur Tihar, Nepal's day of the dog: a dog blessing ceremony with traditional tika and marigold garlands, red-carpet dog walk, cultural performances, food trucks, local business booths, and pet adoption resources.
